standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

detail.note: The former unsupported gaps are backed by the new structure while the separate lofted cushions and restrained cloth remain legible.

underside.note: The three closed seat bases and original metal feet remain complete; the connected rear support meets the platforms.

front.note: The frame and bedding now span the intended width while the two drawer fronts fit between the end supports.
